title: Discrete derivative
statement: For a nonnegative integer $n$ and a coordinate $i$, the discrete derivative in coordinate $i$ is the linear operator on real-valued functions on $\{-1,1\}^n$ that sends $f$ to the function whose value at $x$ is $\bigl(f(x^{i,+})-f(x^{i,-})\bigr)/2$, where $x^{i,+}$ and $x^{i,-}$ are obtained by setting coordinate $i$ of $x$ to $1$ and $-1$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
The input is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
